# 8-13-2024 — OFI submitted!!!! 🎉🎉🎉🎉🎉🎉🎉🎉

We should hear back by October 11, 2024. 



Templeton Grant 2024 question

## Notes

**Topics**

[Books by Sir John Templeton](https://archive.org/search?query=creator%3A"Templeton%2C+John%2C+1912-2008")

- [Worldwide Laws of Life. 200 Eternal Spiritual Principles.](https://archive.org/details/worldwidelawsofl0000temp)

- [The Essential Worldwide Laws of Life.](https://archive.org/details/essentialworldwi0000temp)

- Active Inference as framework for exploring epistemological/ontological variations

  - E.g. multiagent setting with over-/under-fitting agents, multiple realities (??) 

    - With multiple realities/agents — if they are fully partitioned/isolated, they are embedded and isolated in some unified thing. Or to the extent that they do interact, they are in some single unified thing. Reality is truth. 

    - Is there a universal relationship with such a reality? 

      - [https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_suptXYov](https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_suptXYov) ? Can we use [https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_suli3zvK](https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_suli3zvK) and other methods to explore possibilities for cognitive interfaces with reality and truth.  

- Low/High Road — What is the bottom-up/top-down situation, who deemed this? 

- Innocence. → Overfitting of Experience is dogmatism. Absolute Truth — Everyone has a window/perspective/view on Absolute Truth that can be developed and expressed (e.g. with non-linear questions like What is your deepest value?). 

- Active Inference:

  - Gives two-fold between Experience (M1) and Questions/Uncertainty (M2), opening up the possibility of understanding the relationship (M3).



Community organizing

- Inverted pyramid. 

  - People

    - Leader is full-time supported. 

    - Equivalent amount split across 5 people (e.g. $5,000/year)

      - Maybe doing some training. 

    - Equivalent amount split across 25 people ($1,000/year)

      - Take what you are working 

  - Other Institute activities & workshops 

  - Overhead = +10%

  - 

Application instructions — 

- On August 13th we will:

  - Review any comments on the answers. 

  - Review ready-for-submission state, make any last edits or side-notes. 

  - Daniel: Log in the application portal, ensure we are all ready to make the transfer. 

- August 13th after meeting, or 14th probably — D will upload to the application portal.
